adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 46 in app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but there is no `.catch()` handler for the promise. In contrast, the save action on line 38 properly handles errors with `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the destroyRecord API call fails, the user will not see any error message and the UI will remain in an inconsistent state. This is a real defect in error handling.
